easy.def: A thing you hold over your head to keep the rain off.
easy.example: Take an umbrella. It is raining.

more.def: A folding cover on a handle that you hold over yourself to keep off rain or sun.
more.example: The wind turned my umbrella inside out.

more.def: Not feeling relaxed or at ease, or causing that feeling.
more.example: The hard bench was uncomfortable to sit on for long.

easy.example: My shoes are underneath the bed.

more.def: Below or under something, often covered by it.
more.example: We found the key underneath the flowerpot.

easy.example: I understand the rules of the game.

more.def: To know the meaning of something or how it works.
more.example: After the teacher drew a picture, I understood the math problem.

more.def: Being the only one of its kind; unlike anything else.

easy.def: Everything there is: the Earth, the sun, the stars, and all of space.
easy.example: There are many stars in the universe.

more.def: Everything that exists, including all the stars, planets, and space.
more.example: Scientists use telescopes to study faraway parts of the universe.

easy.def: Not what you see every day.
easy.example: A blue apple would be unusual.

more.def: Not common or ordinary; different from what you expect.
more.example: It is unusual to see snow here in April.

easy.example: I was upset when I lost my toy.

more.def: Unhappy, worried, or angry about something.
more.example: She was upset that her best friend was moving away.

easy.def: Needing to be done right now.
easy.example: It is urgent! We need help fast.

more.def: Very important and needing attention right away.
more.example: The doctor got an urgent call from the hospital.

easy.def: Able to help you do something.
easy.example: A map is useful on a trip.

more.def: Helpful; able to be used for a purpose.
more.example: A flashlight is a useful thing to bring on a camping trip.
